posts.name: LACK OF SUBTLETY
posts.cooked:
I got my tracking number for my order the other with an expected delivery on Saturday. Great! I contact friends and arrange a game on Sunday to break it all in.

Then the tracking shows the package go from St. Louis, right past Louisville, Ky (it's destination) to Independence, Ky and from there to Indianapolis, In. The delivery date has now been moved back to Monday.

The villainous FedEx has me in it's clutches and I am powerless against its' cruel games.

posts.name: ricky.pattillo
posts.cooked:
If it is being sent via FedEx SmartPost then it is going to the nearest SmartPost hub, of which there are only 25 in United States, for hand off to the USPS.  The nearest hub to you is in Indianapolis, Indiana.  http://www.fedex.com/us/smart-post/network.html  

Out of curiosity, did you pay for FedEx SmartPost or FedEx Home Delivery when you preordered?  There are several people that paid extra for Home Delivery but received SmartPost shipping. https://greaterthangames.com/forum/topic/shipping-fulfillment-issues-8109

posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
Yes, they will. As a delivery driver, that happens all the time. As long as there isn’t another street with the same name but the other qualifier in the zipcode it will plot it to the street that’s closest. And we deliver drivers generally know our way around.

If you’re worried, call 1800 go FedEx, tell them your expecting a package, but you don’t have the tracking number, and that you might have put in Lane instead of drive or whatever. They can find it and fix it.
